notes: Contract-validated form of CLAIM_TABLE.json. Every entry round-trips through schemas/claim_contract.Claim.from_dict(...). Each claim adds `scope_envelope`, `data_source`, and `sensitivity` blocks beyond the minimum schema for downstream pinning.

C000.observable: presence of seven scope dimensions in an automation / efficiency claim text
C000.rate_equation: d(admissibility)/d(scope_specification) = +1 if all seven dimensions present, else 0

bounds.spatial: any claim text passed to validate_scope_specification

conditions: claim text is in plain English
regex patterns for the seven dimensions can detect any acknowledgment
invalid_if: a primary-source claim that explicitly answers all seven scope questions AND publishes a measurable falsifier
measured_by: manual annotation of canonical pitch corpus
relational_web: feeds into every other C001-C032 verdict

C001.observable: trip-weighted mean pairwise Jaccard distance between same-OD waypoint sets
conditions: route log has at least 2 trips per OD pair
waypoint identifiers are stable (HD-mapped node IDs or equivalent)
invalid_if: working autonomous deployment with mean Jaccard distance > 0.20
sensitivity: definition of OD pair (city-pair vs site-pair)

conditions: task inventory enumerated against canonical 20-task list
automation_status assigned per task from {fully_automated, partially_automated, remote_operator, human_required}
invalid_if: documented end-to-end automation including pump operation at variable sites

C003.observable: per-route-mile infrastructure capex with existing-state discounts across 7 line items
C003.rate_equation: d(infra_capex)/d(route_mile) = sum(unit_cost_i * (1 - existing_pct_i)) + receiving_sites_per_mile * pad_cost + comms_per_5mi

bounds.spatial: per route-mile of dispersed-well service area

conditions: existing_*_pct values are in [0, 1]
unit costs are 2025 US dollars (override otherwise)
invalid_if: cost data showing dispersed-well infrastructure < vehicle fleet cost

C004.observable: lifecycle EROI vs production decline curve
conditions: decline_curve in fractional multipliers per year
energy_input and energy_output denominated consistently (joules)
invalid_if: profitable autonomous deployment on <3yr wells

C005.observable: secondary-market retention curve by equipment type
conditions: equipment_type in {conventional_class8, autonomous_retrofit, purpose_built_autonomous}
years_elapsed in [0, 10]
invalid_if: active secondary market at >40% retention

C006.observable: scope-collapse markers in pitch text vs scope-honest markers
C006.rate_equation: d(collapse_score)/d(pitch_length) = +1 per overreach marker, -1 per scope-honest marker

bounds.spatial: any pitch / press release / investor deck

conditions: pitch is in English
regex patterns include domain vocabulary
invalid_if: scope-honest deployment language in primary sources

C007.observable: wage suppression coincident with threat-narrative deployment
conditions: threat narrative active (regex match in regional press)
productivity_change_pct measurable from BLS data
invalid_if: wage data showing parity or increase post-automation
data_source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages

C008.observable: lifecycle ratio of sensor-stack replacement cost to driver-performed monitoring labor cost
conditions: task list covers DOT pretrip + posttrip + mid-shift inventory
sensor cost envelope is 2025 US
invalid_if: deployed system showing <2x cost of driver-performed monitoring

C009.observable: set difference between human-only precursor catches and sensor-detected catches
conditions: human_caught and sensor_caught lists enumerated from same incident corpus
invalid_if: documented parity in catch rates for subtle/precursor failures

C010.observable: autonomous-to-human ratio of expected roadside-breakdown cost

bounds.spatial: single incident, all US route classes

conditions: failure_type in canonical taxonomy
location_remoteness in [0, 1]
invalid_if: insurance/operational data showing parity

bounds.scale: annual USD per vehicle per interface

conditions: interface inventory enumerated against canonical 7-item list
mobile_escalation_pct given
invalid_if: audited middleware lifecycle cost at <2x driver-mediated cost

C012.observable: expected annual cost of unhandled interface variants

bounds.spatial: across all customer / fuel / regulatory / roadside touchpoints

conditions: variant_count is the empirical count of distinct conventions seen in the field
miss_rate is per-interface autonomous handler coverage gap
invalid_if: autonomous deployment with documented handler coverage for >95% of field variants

C013.observable: distributed-labor annual cost per truck supported as fraction of replaced driver fully-loaded cost

bounds.spatial: per truck supported by the off-vehicle workforce
bounds.scale: fully-loaded USD per role per truck

conditions: stack includes remote operator, mobile tech, customer service, diagnostic specialist, compliance officer, ML-ops, data labeling
driver fully-loaded baseline is wages + benefits + payroll tax + per-diem
invalid_if: audited distributed-labor cost below 25% of replaced driver fully-loaded cost

C014.observable: annual value of CDL driver-exercised refusals under FMCSA / OSHA / STAA
conditions: refusal categories enumerated from canonical FMCSA / OSHA / STAA list
value_per_event reflects cost averted by the refusal
invalid_if: documented autonomous deployment with legally recognized refusal authority at parity with a CDL driver

C015.observable: expected unrecovered share across 7-participant liability stack
conditions: coverage_share sums to ~1 across the 7 participants
disclaim_probability per participant reflects current case law and insurance posture
invalid_if: settled liability chain with insurance markets pricing autonomous-specific coverage at less than 2x conventional rates

C016.observable: weighted override-resolution coverage across 7 historical override categories
conditions: override categories enumerated from historical driver-decision corpus
coverage_pct measurable from autonomous-system production logs
invalid_if: documented autonomous override-resolution coverage of >90% of historical driver override events

C017.observable: annual autonomous-vs-conventional cost ratio across 10 framework line items + 6 litigation categories
conditions: fleet_size given to compute per-truck premium
litigation probabilities reflect 2025-era case-law posture
invalid_if: deployed autonomous trucking operation showing legal and regulatory framework cost at <1.5x conventional, sustained over 3 consecutive years

C018.observable: weighted human domain expertise retention across 6 skill atrophy curves
C018.rate_equation: d(retention)/d(years_into_transition) follows SKILL_ATROPHY_CURVES per skill, weighted

bounds.spatial: human workforce in transition to AI-handled operations

conditions: skill_weights sum to ~1
atrophy curves are reliable for the target workforce
invalid_if: deployment where AI-dominant system experiences edge-case failure AND humans successfully recover without catastrophic cost

C019.observable: edge-case recovery cost (scaled by deskilling) vs apparent monoculture savings
conditions: edge_case_frequency_per_vehicle from operational data
retention pulled from C018
invalid_if: operational deployment where monoculture edge-case recovery cost is less than hybrid-redundancy steady-state cost

C020.observable: honest eROI vs apparent eROI for autonomous trucking
conditions: all energy stack categories included (truck, server, network, manufacturing, embodied)
amortization horizon explicit
invalid_if: audited end-to-end energy accounting showing autonomous eROI > 1.5 across server, manufacturing, extraction, and network energy stacks
data_source: LBNL US Data Center Energy Usage Report
IEA Networks and AI energy outlooks

bounds.spatial: fleet across whatever geographic footprint it covers

conditions: coefficients reflect the deployment's actual cost structure (not industry averages necessarily)
invalid_if: audited multi-scale deployment data showing total energy cost per ton-mile monotonically decreasing across at least three orders of magnitude of fleet size

C022.observable: ratio of institution size to optimal scale point

bounds.spatial: institution operating in an industry with an optimal scale point

conditions: optimal_size known (from C021 or domain study)
institution has discretionary capital allocation authority
invalid_if: institution-backed research showing smaller scale is more efficient (rare because institution funding research is invested in scale)

C023.observable: fraction of documented substrates excluded from institutional funding / publication / policy

bounds.spatial: the institutional research field around autonomous logistics

conditions: substrate inventory is comprehensive of plausible alternatives
exclusion verified against funding / publication / policy channels
invalid_if: substantive funded program studying decentralized / symbiotic / degraded-mode alternatives at parity with institution-scaled programs
data_source: Web of Science / Scopus indexed publications

C024.observable: 5-phase collapse cycle position with adaptive capacity score
C024.rate_equation: d(adaptive_capacity)/d(ratio_to_optimum) = -1 above 1.5x optimum, modulated by observed response
conditions: optimal_size known
observed_response in {doubled_down, partial, successful_adapt}
invalid_if: large institution successfully adapts to fundamental market / resource constraint without collapse
measured_by: historical institution case studies (Roman, Soviet, Blockbuster, Kodak, ICE auto, 2008 financial)

C025.observable: 10-year probability of any of 7 preconditions failing, weighted by degraded-mode capability

bounds.spatial: fleet operating across one or more national jurisdictions

conditions: deployment_type assigned (autonomous_no_driver / hybrid_with_safety_driver / fully_remote_operator / human_driver_only)
earth_system_trends within 2026-2036 envelope
invalid_if: autonomous deployment that remains operational through a 24-hour regional power outage AND satellite signal loss AND 72-hour regional internet disruption AND 6-month critical-parts supply break AND geopolitical rare-earth embargo

C026.observable: destabilization-mechanism count across 5 economic-model coupling effects
C026.rate_equation: d(double_bind)/d(deployment_scale) = +1 per mechanism activated by deployment

bounds.spatial: automation deployment within its economic system

conditions: mechanism inventory enumerated against canonical 5-mechanism list
destabilization_strength scored per mechanism
invalid_if: automation deployment that does not depend on continuous growth, has supply-chain diversification adequate to absorb any single jurisdiction's restriction, and demonstrates resilience to economic shock without external bailout

C027.observable: 5-test validity battery against claim text (energy-grounded, optimization reduces energy, causal, scarcity-robust, models failure)

bounds.spatial: any economic claim about an automation deployment

conditions: claim is in natural language or structured dict
energy-grounding regex patterns include domain vocabulary
invalid_if: economic model that predicts outcomes accurately during conditions of resource scarcity (where money != energy)

bounds.spatial: institution operating on a non-energy-grounded model

conditions: organization_type classified
alternative_models_available counted
invalid_if: economic model that successfully adapts to fundamental resource scarcity without institutional collapse or reversal

C029.observable: fraction of 9 capital forms with nonzero entries in deployment's reported accounting
conditions: reported accounting is what the operator publishes (10-K, sustainability report, marketing pitch)
9 capital forms enumerated against canonical list
invalid_if: financial deployment publishing audited per-period accounting that includes nonzero entries against all nine capital forms with comparable denominators
sensitivity: which capital forms are externalized (typically all but financial+labor)

C030.observable: joules-equivalent deficit (sum of non-financial capital losses minus financial capital gain) over 30-year horizon
conditions: joules-per-unit conversion factors specified (defaults: financial 3.6e6, environmental 3.0e9/ton CO2, etc.)
all 9 capital forms have annual extraction values
invalid_if: large-scale automation deployment where financial_capital_gained > sum(all_other_capital_losses) when all capitals are denominated in comparable units (joules-equivalent or years-to-recovery)

bounds.spatial: any economic model used for billion-dollar deployment decisions

conditions: claim is a structured dict OR text containing regime / design-margin / falsifier markers
definition and input stability scores reflect current institutional posture
invalid_if: published economic model that satisfies all four engineering-grade criteria explicitly and has been third-party-audited under stress
data_source: NASA / DNV / NRC engineering validation documentation
FRED / BLS / USGS input volatility data

C032.observable: regime-validation coverage + training-to-deployment regime drift severity

bounds.spatial: AI deployment operating on an economic model

conditions: model carries regimes_validated list
training_regime and deployment_regime classified against 4-regime taxonomy
invalid_if: AI economic model that successfully predicts outcomes during a fundamental market regime shift (supply shock, geopolitical disruption, currency devaluation, regulatory overhaul)
measured_by: historical cascade cases (LTCM, 2008, 2010 flash crash, March 2020)

C033.observable: end-to-end latency from anomaly onset to action signal back, human-inline vs cloud-centralized
C033.rate_equation: d(response)/d(anomaly_severity) = anomaly_perception + decision_to_act (human) vs telemetry + inference + dispatcher + action (cloud)

bounds.spatial: single autonomous vehicle in operational corridor

conditions: operator is in cab (human-inline) or remote (cloud-centralized)
telemetry link is live
invalid_if: cloud system with <5sec end-to-end latency to precursor anomalies

C034.observable: fraction of operational constraints with no reliable digitization path

bounds.spatial: operator domain knowledge for a specific corridor / route

conditions: constraint inventory enumerated
digitizability assessed against current sensor/AI envelope
invalid_if: knowledge transfer system capturing > 90% of embodied constraints in form retrievable without the human present

C035.observable: asymmetry ratio between centralized and distributed decision latency
conditions: decisions_per_shift quantified
distributed and centralized paths timed end-to-end
invalid_if: centralized system with < 30sec end-to-end latency for anomaly -> dispatcher approval -> vehicle action

C036.observable: training data span coverage of slowest operational mode
C036.rate_equation: d(coverage)/d(training_span_days) = +1 once span >= 3 * period_days for each cycle

bounds.spatial: any AI deployment that depends on time-varying inputs
bounds.temporal: training-data horizon vs operational cycle period

conditions: operational cycles enumerated (circadian, weekly, seasonal, interannual, decadal)
invalid_if: model trained on data spanning >= 3 full cycles of slowest operational mode (typically seasonal) including all uncovered cycles
sensitivity: slowest operational cycle period (typically seasonal or interannual)

C037.observable: relative accuracy drop on held-out-season test data

bounds.spatial: any AI deployment evaluated on cross-season holdout

conditions: in-season and held-out-season accuracy measured on comparable tasks
invalid_if: model deployed on data spanning 10+ years of seasonal variation AND tested on different-season holdout with < 10% accuracy drop

C038.observable: hours of operational exposure required for competence (human apprentice vs AI)
C038.rate_equation: d(competence)/d(exposure_hours) saturates around 8000h for humans; AI plateaus at 100-1000h without novel-test passage

bounds.spatial: knowledge transfer event (apprentice or trainer or training pipeline)

conditions: human apprenticeship hours from DOL standard
AI training-exposure hours from disclosed dataset inventory
novel-situation tests defined
invalid_if: AI system demonstrating equivalent judgment to human apprentice after < 8000 hours of training exposure AND passing novel-situation tests
data_source: US Department of Labor registered apprenticeship database

C039.observable: annual energy cost of maintaining human workforce vs cloud backend for equivalent fleet
conditions: workforce_size and fleet_size known
human metabolic baseline known (~2.5 kWh/day)
invalid_if: cloud backend running 24/7 for fleet consumes less energy than keeping equivalent human workforce in active practice

C040.observable: minimum operational capacity across single-infrastructure failure modes
conditions: per-failure-mode capacity assessed for GPS / cloud / electricity / fuel loss
invalid_if: autonomous deployment demonstrating > 30% operational capacity through non-digital, non-cloud pathways

C041.observable: fraction of operational knowledge that survives total infrastructure loss across generations
C041.rate_equation: d(survival)/d(time_horizon_years) = weighted_mean of per-element survival fractions
conditions: knowledge inventory enumerated across substrate forms
invalid_if: autonomous deployment requiring < 20% external infrastructure for operational continuity across 100 years

C042.observable: time to cognitive coherence budget exhaustion under threat-adaptive overhead

bounds.spatial: single agent operating in a defined regime

conditions: deployment regime classified (safe_reciprocal / threat_mixed / chaotic)
overhead_per_day measurable from behavioral logs
invalid_if: sustained threat-adaptive behavior with no measurable value erosion or system degradation over >=12-month operational window

C043.observable: enforcement_cost(N) vs reciprocal_cost(N): crossover scale N
conditions: population known
per-capita enforcement and reciprocal coefficients calibrated to context
invalid_if: sustained coercive system with enforcement cost < reciprocal governance equivalent at same scale AND without corruption growth
data_source: national budget time series (USSR, East Germany, China, US)

C044.observable: expected value of corruption (bribe - detection*penalty) vs enforcer salary
conditions: mean_bribe_offer measurable from disclosed bribery cases
detection_probability and penalty estimable from prosecution data
invalid_if: large enforcement bureaucracy operating with stable salary structure and audited corruption rate below 1% over a 10-year window
measured_by: Russian customs / Mexican drug enforcement case studies

C045.rate_equation: d(sustainability_score)/d(reciprocity_legitimacy) = ratio of perceived-protection factors over perceived-extraction factors
conditions: four dimensions scored on [0, 1]
invalid_if: coercive system in an extraction-incentivized culture that maintains surveillance cost sustainability over a 20-year horizon

C046.observable: coefficient-of-variation of prosecution rates across wealth deciles
conditions: prosecution rates measurable per wealth decile
invalid_if: coercive system applying enforcement equally across the wealth distribution AND maintaining cost-sustainable trajectory over a 20-year horizon, OR reciprocal-culture system applying enforcement unequally AND maintaining cooperation

C047.observable: defensive spending share of GDP across 11 canonical categories
conditions: spending categories enumerated against canonical 11-category list
GDP from national accounts
invalid_if: audited national accounting where prison + surveillance + enforcement spending < 3% of GDP, defensive spending excluded from headline GDP, AND equal-justice application is third-party verified

C048.observable: asymmetric-share across 8 canonical regulations between biological and digital substrates

bounds.spatial: regulatory framework for autonomous + human operations

conditions: regulation inventory enumerated
biological and digital enforcement status assessed
invalid_if: regulatory framework that applies identical scrutiny to human and AI decision-making across 24/7 operations, 15-day simulations, and regime-shift scenarios

C049.observable: fraction of above-median-capability operators downregulated by LCD cap
conditions: capability distribution enumerated
regulation_threshold_hours known
invalid_if: HOS regulation that accommodates capability diversity WITHOUT sacrificing safety for below-median operators

C050.observable: system resilience R = (max - min) * N * autonomy
conditions: max + min capability hours measurable
operator_autonomy on [0,1]
invalid_if: regulatory framework that sets a common minimum (not maximum) while preserving capability diversity above the floor
data_source: BLS driver retention by tenure cohort

C051.observable: stakeholder voting weight share advocating capability-bracketing regulation
conditions: stakeholder coalition enumerated
advocacy stance known per stakeholder
invalid_if: regulatory framework whose voting / advisory structure is dominated by top-decile performers AND that increases capability diversity rather than compressing it

C052.observable: mean externalization intensity across documented self-regulation domains
C052.rate_equation: d(atrophy)/d(externalization_intensity) increases monotonically across coupled domains

bounds.spatial: human population subject to externalized regulation

conditions: domain inventory enumerated
externalization intensity scored per domain
invalid_if: population with high regulatory externalization across the documented domains AND maintained high internal self-regulation capacity on validated tests

C053.observable: deployment position in the 4-phase regulatory degradation cycle
conditions: year_since_deployment + regulation_intensity + high_capability_share known
invalid_if: autonomous deployment 10+ years past initial regulatory tightening that maintains capability diversity, edge-case robustness, and operator retention at pre-regulation levels
data_source: historical industry-collapse case studies (rail, garment, factory)

C054.observable: cumulative capability delta from documented prior regulatory interventions
conditions: prior interventions enumerated with years applied and capability deltas
invalid_if: ROI comparison conducted against an audited capable-driver baseline (pre-detraining capability distribution restored or estimated from international unregulated cohorts)

C055.observable: metric count: human-fatigue measured + validated_under_24_7 vs AI-degradation equivalents
conditions: metric inventories enumerated for both substrates
measurement + 24/7 validation status known per metric
invalid_if: published audited AI degradation curves for bit-flip rate, hallucination under load, value drift, decision-quality curve, and recovery protocol, validated under continuous 24/7 operation
sensitivity: AI 24/7 validated metric count (zero or near-zero in 2025)

conditions: per-overhead-category hours measurable
nameplate available_hours_per_day stated
invalid_if: autonomous deployment demonstrating POR > 0.75 sustained over 3+ years, with maintenance, charging, exception resolution, and cloud diagnostic latency itemized and verified

C057.observable: autonomous coordination cost per truck per day vs driver-embedded coordination
C057.rate_equation: d(coordination)/d(automation) = sum(backend + maintenance_sched + exception + interface + remote_op + sw_maint)
conditions: per-category autonomous coordination costs measurable
driver-embedded coordination share of wage estimated
invalid_if: audited per-truck-per-day coordination accounting showing autonomous coordination stack at less than the driver-embedded coordination cost it replaces

C058.observable: deferred catastrophic-failure liability per truck per year when human inspection eliminated
conditions: catastrophic_failure_rate_increase calibrated
fleet_size + lifecycle known
mean_event_cost from disclosed insurance data
invalid_if: autonomous fleet documenting per-truck inspection / monitoring protocol equivalent to or stronger than DOT pretrip + posttrip + in-motion sensing AND maintaining catastrophic failure rate parity with human-inspected fleet over 3+ years

C059.observable: total all-categories daily energy budget (MJ) and seven-function integration score, autonomous vs human-integrated baseline
C059.rate_equation: d(efficiency)/d(integration_score) = sum(integrated_function_energy) vs sum(separated_function_energy); threshold = autonomous_MJ_per_day < human_MJ_per_day AND autonomous_resilience >= human_resilience

bounds.scale: MJ per truck per day + 7-function integration score

conditions: all energy categories itemized for both substrates

7 canonical functions (transport, condition_monitoring, problem_detection, micro_decision_making, coordination, self_maintenance, adaptation_to_novel_conditions) classified per function as integrated / separated / outsourced
invalid_if: autonomous deployment achieving >10% energy savings vs the human-operated baseline AND maintaining or improving resilience to edge cases, with all energy categories itemized and third-party audited
relational_web: overlaps C020, C039, C056, C057, C058
data_source: LBNL US data center energy reports

C060.observable: weighted mean abstraction distance of management coalition + elite overproduction share
conditions: role mix enumerated
abstraction distance scored per role (0 = substrate, 1 = fully abstract)
invalid_if: automation deployment with management coalition dominated by substrate-experienced operators AND elite-overproduction share below 0.3, sustained for 5+ years
relational_web: couples to C022, C023, C051, C062

C061.observable: fully-invisible care-work fraction (no visible cost line item AND no prevented-failure benefit counting)
conditions: care-work inventory enumerated
per-category visibility status documented
invalid_if: cost-accounting framework that line-items each care-work category AND counts prevented failures as benefit; sustained in published reports over 3+ years
relational_web: couples to C002, C008, C047, C062
sensitivity: fraction of categories with both invisible_cost AND uncounted_benefit

C062.observable: per-role inversion = abs(knowledge - authority); mean across roles
conditions: roles enumerated with substrate knowledge and decision authority scored on [0, 1]
invalid_if: organization where role-level knowledge and authority are co-distributed (correlation > 0.7 across roles) AND substrate decisions are made by substrate-knowledgeable roles

conditions: blame cascade enumerated by step / target role
actual culpability share estimable from cause-effect chain
invalid_if: published post-mortem of an automation-substrate failure where the MBA decision-maker who eliminated the care-work line item receives the largest narrative blame share, with the cause-effect chain documented

C064.observable: count of 5 substrate-care preconditions satisfied at deployment time
C064.rate_equation: d(admissibility)/d(precondition) = +1 per precondition satisfied; threshold = all 5
conditions: care_work_continued, care_work_costed_visibly, failure_cost_known, decision_authority_holder_has_substrate_knowledge, approval_required_from_substrate_experienced_operator all assessable
invalid_if: automation deployment in any domain that was approved by someone with substrate operational experience AND maintains care work as a costed line item AND has documented failure-cost-if-care-skipped numbers; sustained without substrate failure for 5+ years
measured_by: cost-accounting line items for care work
sensitivity: any precondition failing triggers concern; care_work_continued and substrate_experienced_operator_approval are most commonly absent

C065.observable: fraction of decision-maker credentials that imply domain substrate knowledge

bounds.spatial: decision-making coalition for an AI deployment

conditions: decision-maker credentials enumerated
credential -> substrate-knowledge mapping documented
invalid_if: decision-making body where >= 50% of credentials directly imply domain substrate knowledge AND the body's decisions are audited against domain-expert validation over 5+ years
measured_by: DOL apprenticeship + ASE / equivalent certification records
sensitivity: share of MBA + management consultant + VC credentials (dominant credentialed-non-expert categories)

C066.observable: mean domain-expert decision authority + warning-action rate across institutional inventory
C066.rate_equation: d(gatekeeping)/d(expert_inventory) = sum(authority_granted) / N AND sum(warning_acted) / sum(warning_documented)
conditions: domain experts enumerated
decision authority + warning action rate measurable from documented records
invalid_if: institutional process where domain experts hold >= 20% mean decision authority AND >= 30% of their documented warnings are acted upon over a 5-year window
sensitivity: mean_authority_granted (typically near zero in current institutions)

C067.observable: credentialed share of AI training corpus across 12 corpus categories

bounds.spatial: AI training corpus for a deployment domain

conditions: corpus composition documented by source category
credentialed vs domain-expert classification applied
invalid_if: AI training corpus with >= 20% sourced from non-credentialed domain experts (field notes, operator conversations, apprenticeship documentation, oral traditions) AND validated to outperform credentialed-only baseline on domain tasks
measured_by: Common Crawl / academic corpus composition analyses

C068.observable: 7-step credential-inversion failure-mode pattern match across 12-case library + any candidate deployment
C068.rate_equation: d(pattern_match)/d(case_library) = count(cases satisfying all 7 step markers) / total_cases
conditions: decision_makers_substrate_knowledge + warning_documented + warning_acted_upon + blamed_on + actual_cause all assessable
invalid_if: AI deployment where decision-makers had substrate knowledge documented in advance OR where domain expert warnings were acted upon OR where post-failure blame was correctly attributed to decision-maker rather than to AI / data / compute, AND the deployment succeeded
measured_by: case-study library (Watson Oncology, Facial Recognition, Amazon Hiring, Welfare, Predictive Policing, Zillow, FB Moderation, Target Pregnancy, MS Tay, Knight Capital, Uber Autonomy, IBM Drug Discovery)
data_source: academic post-mortems (e.g. ProPublica COMPAS, FTC Watson reports)

C069.observable: share of post-failure blame attributions that produce institutional learning (vs blame redirected to AI / data / compute)
conditions: post-mortem record enumerates attributed blame
blame -> institutional-learning mapping applied
invalid_if: post-mortem record of AI deployment failures where >= 50% of attributed blame is to decision-authority structure / domain expert exclusion / consultation process AND the institution demonstrably changed its decision process as a result
relational_web: couples to C022, C024, C063, C068
data_source: academic case studies (Charles Perrow, Diane Vaughan)
sensitivity: AI_not_ready / training_data / algorithm_bias categories (dominant; do not produce learning)

C070.observable: weighted-mean popularity trend minus weighted-mean substrate-health trend across panels
conditions: popularity_trend signed rates per metric measured
substrate_trend signed rates per metric measured (positive = healthy)
invalid_if: popular framework / deployment achieving > 10%/year popularity growth AND > 5%/year substrate-health improvement over a 5-year window, third-party audited
relational_web: couples to C027, C028, C047, C071
sensitivity: weighting of substrate metrics (resilience vs energy vs skill)

C071.rate_equation: d(metric)/dt sign + d2(metric)/dt2 sign -> phase ID; corr(normalized series A, B) -> shape match
conditions: metric_time_series of at least 5 points
for shape-match, two normalized series of >= 3 points each
invalid_if: adoption-metric time series across 3+ domains at different timescales whose normalized curves do NOT match the canonical discovery -> adoption -> saturation -> collapse shape (curve_shape_match correlation < 0.85)
sensitivity: window size for slope / acceleration estimate

C072.observable: ratio of decision-maker tenure to cycle timescale
C072.rate_equation: visibility = min(1.0, tenure_years / cycle_timescale_years); blind when visibility < 0.5
conditions: decision-maker tenure documented
cycle timescale measurable from historical examples
invalid_if: decision-maker class with documented track record of anticipating own institution's cycle collapse AND pivoting in advance, sustained over multiple cohorts
relational_web: couples to C022, C024, C053, C071

C073.observable: externalized end-of-life cost as share of true lifecycle total
conditions: capex, opex, lifecycle_years, salvage_value, eol_externalized_cost all assessable
invalid_if: published financial model where end-of-life disposal, materials recovery, waste-stream liability, and obsolescence-transition cost are each itemized AND the total lifecycle cost matches the visible total within 10%
sensitivity: eol_externalized_cost_usd (dominant; default captures stranded-asset reality from C005)

C074.observable: count of 3 end-of-life accountability preconditions satisfied (second_life_designed, materials_recovery_designed, designer_accountable_for_eol)
conditions: 3 preconditions assessable at design phase
invalid_if: automation deployment with declared second-life pathway, third-life materials recovery, AND designer contractually accountable for end-of-life cost, sustained over a full obsolescence-transition cycle

C075.rate_equation: d(health)/d(metric) = +1 per effectiveness signal, -1 per adoption signal
conditions: adoption metrics enumerated (stars, VC funding, viral spread, etc.)
effectiveness metrics enumerated (post-mortem refs, risk-manager adoption, predicted-then-prevented count)
invalid_if: framework that achieves widespread VC / executive adoption AND demonstrably prevents the failures it predicts, audited over 5+ years with verifiable predict-then-prevent record
measured_by: post-mortem citation counts + risk-manager adoption records (effectiveness)
relational_web: self-reflexive meta-claim; couples to C000, C070

C076.observable: share of substrate-knowledge corpus classes pruned at projected token price
conditions: token price trajectory documented
per-class curation cost per useful token measurable
invalid_if: AI training corpus at >= $10/MTok token price that retains >= 70% of high-curation-cost substrate-knowledge corpus classes, third-party audited
relational_web: couples to C020, C067, C077, C078

C077.observable: years remaining in archival window before exclusion completion

bounds.spatial: global AI training corpus inclusion process

conditions: filtering_onset_year and exclusion_completion_year documented
invalid_if: documented archival of substrate-knowledge corpora into major training datasets (Common Crawl, The Pile, academic domain corpora) before exclusion completion, with audit trail showing inclusion in subsequent model training runs

C078.observable: synthetic-content share of AI training corpus + substrate-content share

bounds.spatial: AI training corpus across model generations

conditions: synthetic-share trajectory documented per year
substrate-share measurable for current corpus
invalid_if: model trained at >= 50% synthetic content share AND retaining >= 5% substrate-knowledge content, with audited diversity / accuracy comparable to pre-synthetic-dominance baselines

C079.observable: fraction of 8-step institutional-cascade markers matched in an audit report
C079.rate_equation: d(cascade_match)/d(step) = +1 per step whose claim-level marker registers; threshold = 5/7 observable steps
conditions: audit report covers the 7 claim-level steps (C000, C065, C067, C068, C069, C076, C078)
invalid_if: deployment cohort traversing the 4-phase adoption curve without matching 5+ of the 8-step cascade markers, audited over a full obsolescence-transition cycle
measured_by: the audit report itself; this is a synthesis claim that scans existing per-claim verdicts
relational_web: synthesis of C000 + C065 + C067 + C068 + C069 + C076 + C078
data_source: aggregate of per-step claim data sources
sensitivity: which cascade-step claims register; default works case matches all observable steps because the cascade is systemic

C080.observable: realized collaborative-intelligence value as fraction of potential value, given documented barriers
C080.rate_equation: realized_value = 1 - sum(barrier_block_pct); threshold met when realized < 0.25
conditions: barriers enumerated against canonical 5-barrier list (training corpus, credential hierarchy, institutional reward, decision authority, framework popularity)
invalid_if: documented institutional process where substrate-knowledge partners and synthesis-capability partners coordinate freely AND the outputs are integrated into decision-authority AND training corpora, sustained over 5+ years
relational_web: synthesis of C062, C067, C070, C075
data_source: academic case studies of cross-disciplinary collaboration

C081.observable: documented Gottman-aligned vs popular-advice divorce-rate ratio
C081.rate_equation: ratio = popular_divorce_rate / gottman_divorce_rate; threshold met when ratio >= 2.0
conditions: Gottman empirical profile documented (4 Horsemen, ~90% predictive accuracy)
popular-advice outcome rate documented from population baseline
invalid_if: peer-reviewed long-term follow-up study showing Gottman-aligned marriages have divorce rate >= popular-advice marriages, OR documenting that Gottman research is now equally represented in major AI training corpora as popular relationship advice
relational_web: empirical case of C079 cascade in non-AI domain

C082.observable: 1000-couple study design with predicted 3.46x divorce-rate ratio at 7yr follow-up
C082.rate_equation: study supported if observed_ratio >= 2.0; falsified if observed_ratio < 2.0
conditions: randomized assignment to Gottman-advice (group A) vs popular-AI-advice (group B)
primary outcome divorce rate at 7yr documented
invalid_if: randomized 1000+ couple study where group A (Gottman-principle advice) and group B (popular AI advice) at 7-year follow-up show divorce-rate ratio < 2.0
relational_web: concrete falsifier for the cascade C079; couples to C081
data_source: proposed RCT design; no published equivalent exists yet
sensitivity: intervention fidelity in group A (Gottman protocols are detailed)

C083.observable: fraction of cross-domain comparisons where empirically-grounded outperforms popular by >= 2x
C083.rate_equation: d(structural_pattern)/d(domain) = +1 per domain matching pattern; threshold = match_share >= 0.80 AND mean_ratio >= 2.0

bounds.spatial: across 4+ canonical domains (relationships, healthcare, education, finance, software, automation)

conditions: per-domain empirically-grounded baseline + popular alternative + observed outcome ratio documented
invalid_if: documented domain in which popular (broadly-cited, training-corpus-included) approaches outperform empirically-grounded (narrowly-cited, training-corpus-excluded) approaches by >= 2x on a primary outcome metric, with the comparison third-party audited
relational_web: synthesis of C081 + C082; cross-domain validation of C079 cascade
sensitivity: which domains are surveyed (selection bias risk)
